tabs.label: Compose
tabs.headline: Music that carries a world
tabs.body: Alexandre produces music in his free time and wants to be hired as a composer for video games — writing themes, stingers, and atmospheres that make levels feel alive.

tabs.label: Levels
tabs.headline: Spaces players learn by playing
tabs.body: Through Unity projects like Level and The Arena, he designs puzzles and encounters that teach mechanics through space, pacing, and curiosity — not walls of text.

tabs.label: Azure
tabs.headline: DevOps on Microsoft Azure
tabs.body: Alongside creative work, Alexandre works with Microsoft Azure DevOps — bringing reliable delivery, automation, and cloud craft to teams that ship.
